standard.summary: 训练后用 PickScore / ImageReward / HPSv2 对生成图打偏好分。默认关。
standard.effect: 开启后质量评估会额外跑偏好 scorer，权重较重。
standard.whenToUse: 需要人类偏好对齐信号、且已开启质量评估时。
standard.avoidWhen: 仅想看 FID/CLIP，或本机尚未准备偏好模型权重时。

standard_en.summary: Scores the generated images for preference with PickScore / ImageReward / HPSv2 after training. Off by default.
standard_en.effect: With this on, the quality evaluation also runs the preference scorers, which are fairly heavy.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you need a human-preference alignment signal and quality evaluation is already on.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you only want FID/CLIP, or when the preference model weights are not yet in place on this machine.

advanced.principle: default-off；依赖 quality_evaluation_enabled。模型缺失记 skipped，不静默当 0 分。
advanced.expectedImpact: 额外 VRAM/下载；metrics 多 preference_* 键。

advanced_en.principle: Default off; depends on quality_evaluation_enabled. A missing model is recorded as skipped, not silently scored as 0.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Extra VRAM/downloads; metrics gain several preference_* keys.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Heavy weighting; do not enable by default.
